run_sweep_runner: run a hyperparameter sweep for NSP transformer model training using SLURM batch scripts
run_write_data_chunk_to_file: write filtered data lines to a file using a boolean mask and optional commands-only mode
run_split_data: split dataset files into train, valid, and test splits using PyTorch boolean mask tensors
run_generate_sweep_scripts: generate SLURM batch scripts from a sweep config file for grid search over hyperparameters
run_submit_sweep_jobs: submit all generated SLURM batch scripts via a master shell script to the cluster partition
